title: From paint to print
alt: A fox and heron beside a bridge are reinterpreted in indigo and ochre woodcut.
description: A complete style transformation preserving the animal poses, bridge and surrounding composition.

frames.label: Input
frames.prompt: A richly detailed gouache illustration of a red fox walking from left to right across a narrow wooden bridge over a stream. Exactly one fox with four legs, two ears and one full tail. Tall reeds grow at the left; a large white heron stands beside the stream on the right, with two legs and one folded pair of wings. A round pale sun sits high in the background. Fine organic texture, dark plum, burnt orange and pale cream palette, clear silhouettes, elegant Japanese-inspired editorial composition, no lettering.

frames.label: Result
frames.prompt: Translate this exact composition into an exquisite two-color hand-carved linocut print on textured ivory paper. Use only deep indigo and warm burnt orange ink. Preserve the single fox walking right across the bridge, its four legs and tail, the white heron with two legs at the right, the left reeds and high round sun. Replace painted gradients with deliberate carved hatching, bold cut shapes and subtle ink texture. Keep the original spatial arrangement and all animals.
